title: Kaha Ho Ay Ali Akber
body:
...SADA ZAINAB KI HAI MAQTAL MEIN HAR JA...
...KAHAN HO AYE ALI AKBER KAHA HO...
...PHUPI MAIDAAN MEIN AAYE HAI BETA...
KAHA HO AYE ALI AKBER KAHA HO...
1: mujhe awaz phir apni sunao
Kidar aao mere bache batao.
Bus ab chaya hai nazarao mein andhera.
Kaha ho aye ali akber kaha ho......
2:kamar hai kham basarat mein kami hai.
Bus ek din mein meri duniya luti hai.
Khadam uthte nai mushkil hai chalna.
Kaha ho aye ali akber kaha ho...
3:phupi sadqe zara chehara dikhado.
Tadapte ho kahan akber batado.
Suna hai sene mein tuta hai naizah.
Kaha ho aye ali akber kaha ho.
4:madad ka waqt hai ajao baba.
Mere bache se ab milwao baba.
Nazar ata nai hai koi rasta.
Kaha ho aye ali akber kaha ho...
5:Tadap zainab ki wo allahu akber.
Fugah se har taraf barpa tha mehshar.
Jo dekha khoon mein gaalta hai beta.
Kaha ho aye ali akber kaha ho...
6: kiye jo bain lashe se lipat kar.
Huve ujli rida sub khoon mein tar.
Sada thi kya jiyegi ab yeah dukhiya.
Kaha ho aye ali akber kaha ho...
7: utho akber phupi aaye hai dekho.
Mai marjaungi beta kuch to bolo.
Waha pe hosh hai khaime mein laila.
Kaha ho aye ali akber kaha ho...
8: bayan manzar kare kaise wo laamha.
Sada akber ki zainab ka tadapna.
Behan ko shaine mushkil se sambhala.
Kaha ho aye ali akber kaha ho....
